Type: chair
Name: AmazonBasics Classic Reception Office Chair with Mahogany Wood Finish Legs - Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Caressoft upholstery; Mahogany wood finish legs
Reception chair provides a comfortable place to sit—ideal for a lobby or waiting room Supremely soft and durable Caressoft upholstery in solid black Mahogany wood finish legs with a slight outward flare for added stability 250-pound weight capacity; sleek contemporary style Measures 26.5 by 26.5 by 35.5 inches (LxWxH); weighs 30.6 pounds; backed by an AmazonBasics one-year limited warranty
